cohort: 180 women who had delivered a baby within the last 24 hours at Lady Willingdon Hospital, Lahore
finding: Periodontal disease, as indicated by CPITN score, clinical attachment loss, and presence of calculus, was found to be a significant predictor of low birth weight infants.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant predictor of low birth weight.
birth_weight: low birth weight defined as <2.5kg, normal birth weight defined as >= 2.5kg
